name: Hong Kong Gold Industry Group Limited
summary: Hong Kong Gold Industry Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the exploration, mining, and processing of iron and ilmenite ores in the People's Republic of China. The company produces and sells iron and titanium concentrates for iron pellets and steel manufacturers. It is also involved in the trading of blended coal, semi-coke, coarse iron powder, and coke; transportation and trading of minerals iron ore mining; processing and sale of iron concentrates; and develops clean energy, such as wind power, photovoltaic power, and solar power.
